referrals.heading: Your referral code
referrals.lede: This is your code, and who has come in through it. Nothing here is a promise — it is a record.
referrals.codeNote: Hand this to the next practitioner you meet. It stays yours.
referrals.shareSubject: A practice portal worth a look
referrals.shareBody: I use Psychefolio for my practice — a practice portal for practitioners. Use my code {code}: {url}
referrals.peopleHeading: Who came in on your code
referrals.peopleNote: First names only — enough to recognise someone you invited.
referrals.zero: Nobody has used your code yet. Share it with one practitioner you would want in the room.
referrals.standingNote: You were among the first practitioners here. That is what this page records, and nothing more.
referrals.noCode: This practice was set up directly rather than through the founding-partner front door, so there is no code attached to it.
